summary: Phase 13 — GET /api/friends/{telegram_id}/suggestions verified end-to-end + smoke regression. 12/12 backend tests PASS (100%). Covers shape/200, 404 for unknown user, group_mates with suggestion_reason='group_mate', friends_of_friends with mutual_friends_count>=1 and suggestion_reason='friends_of_friends', exclusion of existing friends/pending requests/blocked users, privacy filter (show_in_search=False), self-exclusion, cross-list dedup (gm priority), ?limit=2 caps each list separately, sort by first_name asc within equal mutual count. Smoke regression: POST /friends/request/{target}, GET /friends/{tid}/requests, POST /auth/login/email, POST /auth/logout — all green.

minor.issue: First call after a cold/heavily-seeded state is slow (>20s) on the local instance. Subsequent calls run in <500ms. Likely Mongo cold-cache; not a code bug. Workaround applied: warm-up call + 60s timeout in tests.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:15799-15803 builds my_friend_ids ONLY from rows where user_telegram_id=tid. The friends collection is bidirectional (insert_many of both directions in 15296), so this is correct for THIS user. However, get_mutual_friends_count_batch (server.py:14888) issues 1+N queries (one per target). For a user with hundreds of group-mates this is N round-trips. Consider $facet or a single $in-aggregation. Not blocking — works under current scale.

server.py:15820 reads me['group_id'] and queries user_settings.group_id. group_id is the UUID of the group (e.g. '9f7a56e9-...'). If a user is in a group via group_name only (no group_id), they will silently get an empty group_mates list. Worth a quick data-quality check on prod (count of users with non-null group_name AND null group_id).
server.py:15855 fof_ids_sorted top-K is sliced before the user_settings fetch — good for perf. But final sort in 15903 re-orders by name within equal mutual, which is the spec.
Privacy filter logic in _privacy_ok (15866-15870) is permissive by default (returns True if key absent) — matches the spec ('show_in_search!=False'). Verified by test_privacy_hidden_excluded.
Dedup priority (gm wins over fof) implemented at 15848-15850 BEFORE fof_docs fetch — correct & verified by test_cross_list_dedup_gm_priority.

Endpoint does NOT require auth (consistent with /friends/search). Suggests information disclosure surface: any caller can enumerate group_mates of any tid. Consider rate-limit / show_in_search global toggle. Not blocking for engagement-loop MVP.
Response model FriendSearchResult.uid is now populated, enabling FE navigation to /u/{uid}. Verified in test_group_mates_contains_bob_and_charlie.
test_credentials: Ephemeral test_phase13_<ts>_<rand>@test.com / Test1234 created via /api/auth/register/email with random X-Forwarded-For to bypass 5/hr/IP rate-limit. Seeded telegram_ids 19_999_999_001..010 (Alice/Bob/Charlie/Dave/Eve/Frank/Grace/Heidi/Ivan/Judy) — all removed in fixture teardown.
seed_data_creation: Module-scoped autouse fixture seeded 10 user_settings rows in tid range 19999999001-19999999010, 4 friendship pairs (A-D, A-J, D-E, D-F => 8 friends rows), 1 pending friend_request (A→I), 1 user_block (A blocks G). Teardown deletes everything in that tid range from user_settings, friends, friend_requests, user_blocks. No real users were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests target http://localhost:8001 (USE_LOCAL=1, default). Override with USE_LOCAL=0 to use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Test loads /app/backend/.env directly (DB_NAME=test_database, MONGO_URL=mongodb://localhost:27017). Cold-start of /friends/{tid}/suggestions can exceed 20s on first hit — a warmup fixture exists; keep timeout>=30s. Endpoint signature: GET /api/friends/{telegram_id}/suggestions?limit=12, response={group_mates:[FriendSearchResult],friends_of_friends:[FriendSearchResult],total:int}. FriendSearchResult.suggestion_reason is 'group_mate' or 'friends_of_friends' on this endpoint. POST /friends/request lives at /api/friends/request/{target_telegram_id} with body {telegram_id:<sender_tid>} (NOT /api/friends/request).
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. Endpoint and FE service file behave per spec for all 11 listed scenarios + smoke regression. Implementation note for main agent: get_mutual_friends_count_batch is O(N) round-trips; if profile shows up on hot path consider single-aggregation rewrite.
